name: Papercut Bliss
source:
He's your best friend's brother. Is he off-limits? Of course not. Off-limits is when pain starts to replace all the fuzzy feelings... And the bro code is broken.

(https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive)
translation:
他是你死党的亲兄弟。他是碰不得的禁区吗？当然不是。真正的禁区，是当痛楚开始取代所有甜蜜悸动……当兄弟义气守则被彻底打破的那一刻。

[摘自https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive]
